title: Invoice
description: Invoice contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-invoice
  title: Invoice
  description: Invoice contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_invoice_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/invoice
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/invoice
    sourceVersion: fs_invoice_v1
    sourceDigest: 2f269eb323a3083e9d65292d556f639ec51d1de1977cc47657b6c3884f78f081
spec:
  documentType: invoice
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - amount-due
        - due-date
        - invoice-date
        - payment-terms
        - vendor-tax-id-masked
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - currency
        - invoice-number
        - line-item-count
        - purchase-order-number
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - discount-amount
        - shipping-amount
        - subtotal
        - tax-amount
        - total-amount
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - line-items
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - customer-address
        - customer-name
        - vendor-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - vendor-address
  fields:
    - id: invoice-number
      name: invoice_number
      label: Invoice Number
      description: Invoice number
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/invoice_number
    - id: invoice-date
      name: invoice_date
      label: Invoice Date
      description: Invoice date
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/invoice_date
    - id: due-date
      name: due_date
      label: Due Date
      description: Due date
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/due_date
    - id: vendor-name
      name: vendor_name
      label: Vendor Name
      description: Vendor name
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/vendor_name
    - id: vendor-tax-id-masked
      name: vendor_tax_id_masked
      label: Vendor Tax Id Masked
      description: Vendor tax id masked
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/vendor_tax_id_masked
    - id: vendor-address
      name: vendor_address
      label: Vendor Address
      description: Vendor address
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/vendor_address
    - id: customer-name
      name: customer_name
      label: Customer Name
      description: Customer name
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/customer_name
    - id: customer-address
      name: customer_address
      label: Customer Address
      description: Customer address
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/customer_address
    - id: purchase-order-number
      name: purchase_order_number
      label: Purchase Order Number
      description: Purchase order number
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/purchase_order_number
    - id: currency
      name: currency
      label: Currency
      description: Currency
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/currency
    - id: subtotal
      name: subtotal
      label: Subtotal
      description: Subtotal
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/subtotal
    - id: tax-amount
      name: tax_amount
      label: Tax Amount
      description: Tax amount
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/tax_amount
    - id: shipping-amount
      name: shipping_amount
      label: Shipping Amount
      description: Shipping amount
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/shipping_amount
    - id: discount-amount
      name: discount_amount
      label: Discount Amount
      description: Discount amount
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/discount_amount
    - id: total-amount
      name: total_amount
      label: Total Amount
      description: Total amount
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/total_amount
    - id: amount-due
      name: amount_due
      label: Amount Due
      description: Amount due
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/amount_due
    - id: payment-terms
      name: payment_terms
      label: Payment Terms
      description: Payment terms
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/payment_terms
    - id: line-item-count
      name: line_item_count
      label: Line Item Count
      description: Line item count
      dataType: integer
      sourcePath: /fields/line_item_count
    - id: line-items
      name: line_items
      label: Line Items
      description: Individual line items extracted from the invoice
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/line_items
  validationRules:
    - id: invoice-number-present
      severity: error
      description: Invoice number is required for accounts payable matching.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: invoice_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: invoice_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: invoice_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(invoice_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: vendor-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Vendor name is required for payment routing.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: vendor_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: vendor_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: vendor_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(vendor_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-amount-non-negative
      severity: error
      description: Invoice total must be present and non-negative.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: total_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: total_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_amount IS NOT NULL AND total_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: amount-due-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: Amount due cannot be negative.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: amount_due
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: amount_due
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: amount_due IS NULL OR amount_due >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: due-date-not-before-invoice-date
      severity: warning
      description: Due date should not precede invoice date.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: invoice_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: due_date
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: due_date
            right:
              field: invoice_date
      sourceExpression: invoice_date IS NULL OR due_date IS NULL OR due_date >= invoice_date
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      invoice_number:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Primary AP matching key.
      vendor_name:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Vendor identity controls payment and duplicate detection.
      invoice_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Invoice date supports payment terms and aging.
      total_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Total amount is the core payment control field.
      amount_due:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Amount due determines payment amount after credits or partial payment.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-dbrx-instruct
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-sonnet
    maxTokens: 2048
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Invoices are structured documents with common labeled vendor, customer, amount, and payment fields.
      DBRX Instruct is appropriate for high-volume extraction, while Claude Sonnet is retained for messy
      layouts and line item ambiguity.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      invoice_number:
        type: string
        description: Invoice number
      invoice_date:
        type: date
        description: Invoice date
        format: date
      due_date:
        type: date
        description: Due date
        format: date
      vendor_name:
        type: string
        description: Vendor name
      vendor_tax_id_masked:
        type: string
        description: Vendor tax id masked
      vendor_address:
        type: string
        description: Vendor address
      customer_name:
        type: string
        description: Customer name
      customer_address:
        type: string
        description: Customer address
      purchase_order_number:
        type: string
        description: Purchase order number
      currency:
        type: string
        description: Currency
      subtotal:
        type: number
        description: Subtotal
      tax_amount:
        type: number
        description: Tax amount
      shipping_amount:
        type: number
        description: Shipping amount
      discount_amount:
        type: number
        description: Discount amount
      total_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total amount
      amount_due:
        type: number
        description: Amount due
      payment_terms:
        type: number
        description: Payment terms
      line_item_count:
        type: integer
        description: Line item count
      line_items:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            line_number:
              type: string
              description: Line number.
            description:
              type: string
              description: Line description.
            quantity:
              type: number
              description: Quantity.
            unit_amount:
              type: number
              description: Unit amount or price.
            total_amount:
              type: number
              description: Line total amount.
        description: Individual line items extracted from the invoice
    required:
      - invoice_number
      - vendor_name
      - total_amount
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: accounts_payable
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - invoice_number
          - vendor_name
          - total_amount
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - line_items
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
